blind.description: No text, labels, or watermarks are visible on the model or renders. The model is an ornate architectural pillar topped with a balanced scale. It comprises a stepped square plinth base, a cylindrical shaft composed of six coin-like horizontal segments decorated with gold medallions, a flared capital supporting a flat square platform, and a balance scale with a central post, horizontal beam, and two circular pans suspended by rigid triangular struts. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous throughout, with no shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, melted, or fused. The model stands on its own integrated stepped plinth, which sits flat on the floor with no added ground slab or disc. It is fully painted in antique gold/brass and dark emerald green, with no plain black or unpainted areas, and no flame or glow.
blind.from_above: An elongated symmetrical silhouette featuring a horizontal golden crossbeam with a square pyramidal central cap extending to two circular pan rims, positioned directly over the square green-and-gold capital and plinth below.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.5 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 8.5 to 9 feet tall), with a base width of about 2.5 to 3 feet and an upper span across the scale pans of about 5.8 to 6 feet.
